title: Pricing a card from what you can see
target: How to price cards in TCG Card Shop Simulator using the tags, the price-check screen and the reveal, rather than from memory.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Price tags to put on them
A counter to check prices at

steps.do: Put a price on a card before it goes out on display.
steps.because: cards carry their own price tags (InteractableCardPriceTag)

steps.do: Use the price-check screen rather than guessing at the counter.
steps.because: the game has a screen for checking a price (CheckPriceScreen)

steps.do: Price a card at the moment you open it, while you can still see it.
steps.because: there is a price popup at the reveal (CardPricePopupUI)

steps.do: Take rarity into account as well as the card itself.
steps.because: rarity is a fixed set of levels rather than a free number (ERarity)

steps.do: Check the board for what you set rather than trusting your memory.
steps.because: prices are shown on tags and a board of their own (InteractablePriceTag)

commonMistakes: Displaying a card with no price on it.
Pricing from memory after the pack is gone.
Assuming a higher rarity always sells for more.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
